technology-inflection.name: Technology Inflection
technology-inflection.definition: A company on the benefiting side of a technology that has crossed from early users into the mainstream market. The return comes from growth larger than the market expects.

unpriced-quality-growth.name: Unpriced Quality Growth
unpriced-quality-growth.definition: An excellent, hard-to-copy growth engine that the market prices as an ordinary business. The return comes from growth, plus a re-rating once the framing error behind the discount is corrected.

owner-cash-realization.name: Owner Cash Realization
owner-cash-realization.definition: Established cash-generating businesses where the thesis rests on converting repeat-demand operating earnings and retained capital into per-share shareholder value through cash conversion, disciplined reinvestment or capital returns. Cash accessibility, realization timing and governance remain explicit uncertainties; a neutral view can record an unresolved opportunity.

announced-transaction.name: Announced Transaction
announced-transaction.definition: An announced corporate transaction with a bounded payoff and a dated outcome, where the spread between the deal price and the trading price can be read as a completion probability and compared with primary-document evidence on the conditions precedent.

cash-merger.name: Cash Merger
cash-merger.definition: A merger whose consideration is entirely cash, so the payoff if the transaction completes is fixed and does not move with the acquirer's shares.

regulatory-review.name: Regulatory Review
regulatory-review.definition: A transaction whose remaining condition precedent is clearance from named competition or investment authorities, so the outcome turns on the length and result of a stated review.
